answer: The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1537 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vault. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the sable queue while honest agents promoted earlier continues earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 38 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
